name: Kouda
source:
An OtterHalve rescued by Akatora moments before his execution, Kouda serves as a key member of the resistance army. Behind his playful teasing and culinary passion lies a shrewd observer who sees more than he lets on.

His gentle nature makes him a natural caretaker for the resistance, though he can be just as deadly as his comrades when the situation demands it.

Likes: Cooking, swimming, teasing others

Dislikes: Unnecessary violence, ???, bad-tasting food

[From the [url=https://arashi.eccentric-studio.org/en/characters/kouda]official description[/url]]
